lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Reteach and varied practice: graphing systems

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: These two examples show the same idea in two different formats.

items.prompt: Relationship A: x: 0, 1, 2, 3 y: 1, 3, 5, 7. Relationship B: x: 0, 1, 2, 3 y: 7, 6, 5, 4. At which x-value do the two relationships have the same y-value?

steps: Compare the y-values in each table row by row.
At x = 2, Relationship A gives 5 and Relationship B also gives 5.
No other row has matching y-values, so x = 2 is the answer.

items.prompt: Solve the system: y = x + 4 and y = -x + 2. In which quadrant does the intersection lie?

steps: Substitute to get y = -1 + 4 = 3, so the point is (-1, 3).
Since x is negative and y is positive, the point lies in Quadrant II.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt:
Solve the system:
y = -2x + 8
3x - 2y = 12
Use substitution to find the solution (x, y).

Solve the system:
3x + 4y = 6
-2x - 4y = -4
Use elimination to find the solution (x, y).
Classify the system: y = 2x - 17 and y = 2x - 17. Does it have one solution, no solution, or infinitely many solutions?
The reference equation is y = 4x + 19. Which of these equations, paired with the reference, would give the system infinitely many solutions?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Plan A charges a $11 flat fee plus $2 per week. Plan B charges a $5 flat fee plus $3 per week. After how many weeks do the two plans cost the same, and what is that cost?
Plan A charges a $26 flat fee plus $1 per month. Plan B charges a $8 flat fee plus $4 per month. The solution to the system is (6, 32). What does this solution represent?
choices: Plan A costs $32 more than Plan B after 6 months.

items.prompt: System: y = -2x + 9 and y = 2x - 19. Does the point (8, -6) satisfy both equations, fail one, or fail both?
Plan A charges a $56 flat fee plus $8 per week. Plan B charges a $175 flat fee plus $1 per week. The solution to the system is (17, 192). What does the x-coordinate of the solution represent?
choices: The shared cost, in dollars, when the two plans are equal.
The number of weeks after which the two plans cost the same.
The flat fee charged by Plan A.
The difference in cost between the two plans.
